purpose: size the declared formal budget (100 GAN + 100 PN epochs, batch 64) before running it: per-epoch cost, peak GPU memory and per-component checkpoint bytes, measured on the production recipe path rather than inferred
source_split: data/splits/cifar10/split_0 on the AutoDL instance (45,000 train rows; test class-prior 0.4 for positives {0,1,8,9}); the same four-role layout as the local split
local_gpu_verdict: not feasible on the local T600: at batch 64 it held 2.8 GiB of 4 GiB at 97% utilisation and had not completed one GAN epoch in ~20 minutes, so the formal budget would need 20+ hours there; the probe was aborted and moved to the 32 GiB instance
what_this_is_not: not a training result: the probe runs are (2 GAN, 1 PN) and (1 GAN, 2 PN) to solve for per-epoch cost, and the full-budget run is a separate receipt
